p910.CH_boundary: CH is used in the original Rudin construction, not in continuum^aleph0=continuum arithmetic itself.
p910.exact_infinite_lemma: If |M|=continuum, the family of all subsets M\D with D countable has cardinal at most continuum, since |[M]^{<=aleph0}| <= |M|^aleph0=(2^aleph0)^aleph0=2^aleph0.
p910.logical_boundary: Rudin constructs M under CH with every nondegenerate connected N co-countable. This bound applies to connected N AFTER construction; it does not show their homeomorphism types.
p910.no_fake_topology: Finite-set subset counting cannot reproduce a connected, noncompact, pathological subset of the Euclidean plane.

p911.reduction: Uniform beta(d)/d->infinity for bipartite minimum-degree-d targets is equivalent to #911 up to constants via maximum cut and pruning.
p911.remaining_unproved: Prove beta(d)=omega(d), including high-girth C4-free regular bipartite targets.

structural_extraction.finite_boundary: This only proves structural extraction, not size-Ramsey beta(d)=omega(d).
structural_extraction.graph_lemma: Every n-vertex G with e>0 edges has a bipartite subgraph F with e(F)>e/4 and min_degree(F)>=e/(4n).
structural_extraction.proof: A maximum cut keeps >=e/2 edges; remove a vertex of current degree <e/(4n) iteratively. At most n deletions remove <e/4 edges in total.

p911.universal_two_pile: Any target F with m>=1 edges has size-Ramsey number >=2m-1; every host with <=2m-2 edges splits into two color piles <=m-1.
